codeReview.summary: Implementation fully satisfies the feature requirements. /health returns 200 with minimal response (no I/O), /ready checks PostgreSQL and Redis connectivity with proper 503 response when dependencies unavailable. Response includes individual dependency status. Tests cover all scenarios with 100% coverage on health_handler.go. Code follows project conventions, uses proper dependency injection via interfaces, handles nil clients gracefully, and uses context timeouts appropriately.

summary: PASS - Implementation correctly implements /health and /ready endpoints per VAL-API-027, VAL-API-028, VAL-API-029. Health endpoint returns 200 with {status: 'healthy'} without I/O operations. Ready endpoint checks PostgreSQL (Ping) and Redis (Ping) connectivity, returns 200 when both healthy, 503 when any dependency unavailable, with individual dependency status in response. Error handling is proper (nil client checks, error message propagation). Tests cover 9 scenarios including healthy, unhealthy DB, unhealthy Redis, both unhealthy, and uninitialized clients. Worker followed backend-worker skill procedure correctly. No blocking issues.
